verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch is a search engine, so as-you-type instant search is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents search-as-you-type fields, completion suggesters, prefix or autocomplete queries, or millisecond query latency. The only speed mentions are generic marketing ('unprecedented speed') and an indexing refresh-interval tip, neither of which is about per-keystroke search.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deliver as-you-type instant search with millisecond responses so results update on every keystroke
